description: Voyager is stranded in the Delta Quadrant and forced to merge Starfleet and Maquis crews while its first encounters with the Kazon, Vidiians and unfamiliar space establish the cost of the journey home.

s01e01-02.description: Voyager is hurled into the Delta Quadrant while pursuing a Maquis ship, forcing Janeway to unite both crews for a journey home.

s01e03.description: Voyager becomes trapped near a quantum singularity as Janeway chooses B'Elanna over Carey to lead engineering.

s01e04.description: Janeway and Paris are thrown back before a planetary catastrophe and risk causing the very disaster they are trying to prevent.

s01e05.description: Vidiians steal Neelix's lungs, introducing a desperate species harvesting organs to survive a devastating disease.

s01e06.description: Voyager damages a spaceborne life-form while seeking resources and must re-enter the creature to repair the harm it caused.

s01e07.description: A tiny wormhole offers Voyager contact with a Romulan in the Alpha Quadrant, but a temporal complication undermines hopes of rescue.

s01e08.description: Paris is convicted of murder and forced to relive the victim's final moments while Tuvok investigates inconsistencies in the case.

s01e09.description: Kim is transported into an alien culture's afterlife system, forcing both societies to confront radically different beliefs about death.

s01e10.description: A hospitable species possesses technology that could send Voyager thousands of light-years closer to home but refuses to share it.

s01e11.description: Evidence of stolen Federation technology exposes a traitor aboard Voyager and brings Seska's hidden loyalties into the open.

s01e12.description: The Doctor enters a malfunctioning Beowulf holoprogram to recover crew members transformed by an unusual energy life-form.

s01e13.description: Chakotay's disembodied consciousness moves between crewmates as Voyager is drawn toward a dangerous nebula.

s01e14.description: Vidiians separate B'Elanna into fully human and fully Klingon versions, forcing both halves to confront what the other contributes.

s01e15.description: Neelix confronts the scientist who created the weapon that devastated his home colony and killed his family.

s01e16.description: Tuvok trains resistant former Maquis in Starfleet discipline while a bio-neural malfunction spreads through Voyager.

s01e17.description: The Doctor awakens to an apparently empty ship and is told by Barclay that Voyager itself may only be a holodeck illusion.

s01e18.description: A spaceborne mating event triggers Kes's premature reproductive cycle, confronting her and Neelix with an immediate decision about parenthood.

s01e19.description: A spatial distortion rearranges Voyager's internal structure, leaving the crew unable to navigate their own ship.

s01e20.description: Voyager discovers humans abducted from 1930s Earth, including Amelia Earhart, and a thriving colony that offers the stranded crew a choice.
